reviews.text: Dr. Anderson and staff actually took the time to listen to our issue, not dismiss us like the other practice did a week earlier.  He prescribed something that helped our two cats and so far, it's making a huge difference.  We're only one week into a two-week supply of the meds but by day two we already saw great results a a quick turnaround.  Come HERE if you need help, don't gamble on the other guys maybe listening, maybe not.  BHVH actually solves issues, not ignores them.  Thank you.
I have always had a great experience at Bernardo Heights Veterinary Hospital.  Everyone is very friendly and helpful.

I can’t say enough good things about this veterinary clinic! After moving from Arizona with my formerly feral cat, I was so anxious about finding a vet who was comfortable sedating her for an exam. From my very first phone call, everyone was kind, patient, and took the time to answer all of my questions.

Melissa was incredibly thorough and made me feel at ease, and Dr. Roberto was amazing. She listened to all of my concerns about my cat’s itching, grooming, ears, and teeth, and never tried to upsell me on anything. After the exam, Dr. Roberto personally called to let me know everything looked healthy and normal.

The bill was exactly what they quoted, with no surprise charges. It’s so hard to find a veterinary team you completely trust, and I’m so grateful I found this one. I’ll definitely be bringing my cat here from now on. Highly recommend!

Great Service and caring vets + staff. Followed up with us regarding our pets health after TPLO. Pricing was very reasonable and allowed us to do a procedure we otherwise might not have been able to afford for our pup.
Great staff and extremely helpful and very fair pricing. I absolutely recommend if you are looking for a good and trustworthy Vet for your pet this is the place
Meh
Best vet center in San Diego. Caring staff,  tons of follow up and detailed explanations from the vets. Highly recommend.
Great people

We’ve been taking our 3 cats annually to Dr. Roberto at Bernardo Heights VH for several years. We think she’s great, she’s good with the cats, she’s thorough, the cats get a bribery Churu, and the vet techs are nice. We can get appointments quickly if something comes up that we need her to look at. They always call the next day after an appointment to make sure the cats are doing ok. They have a separate cat waiting room, so our babies don’t have to mix with sniffing/barking doggos. We’ve fortunately not had anything serious except one guy had some teeth extracted at BHVH, so I can’t speak to that level of care/expertise yet. The dental tech was great too, took a lot of time to explain what she had done.

I’ve been going to Bernardo Heights Veterinary Clinic for 7 months now with my kitty Ivy and I have been very pleased with the care she’s been getting there. They are very thoughtful and caring there. I was referred there by a longtime trusted friend and I will refer anyone that is looking for a new vet there too!!

I have been coming here to see Dr. Anderson an Dr. Roberto and they are both very kind and give my dog enough time to feel comfortable since she tends to be always nervous she does eventually calm down. We are very happy with the front desk as well and their technicians, I highly recommend recommend them. Thank you very much

I've had a lot of experience with many good veterinarians and staff over the years - BH Veterinary Hospital ranks at the top, no exaggeration. Every single staff member is super professional and efficient - on the phone, via email, in person, follow up calls re: pet welfare...  I'm so impressed.

I suspected my 10 week old puppy had a bladder infection. They took her right in, did the appropriate testing, prescribed the right medication & she's already feeling much better. They proactively call to check on her & we've set up a follow up exam to ensure that she's 100% well. I have every confidence in Bernardo Heights Veterinary Hospital. They always provide above & beyond excellent care. I am grateful for the personal love & attention they have given all my (9) dogs over the past 20 years. Wouldn't have taken them anywhere else. Thank you!

Now that we are in 2023, it was time to take my fur kids back to see their friends at Bernardo Heights Veterinary Hospital.  So far one girl was seen for her yearly check-up, but will be going back again on Wednesday with another kid.  So, as noted in all past reviews, we are all very happy to visit Dr. Anderson & the entire staff.
Just as in past reviews I have posted, I am totally happy with the entire staff at Bernardo Heights Veterinary Hospital.  A few months ago my Golden required TPLO (knee) surgery.  She was well cared for at BHVH & has been making a great recovery - although trying to keep her from doing more than she should is a challenge.  She has been back for her follow-up appts & all have shown that she has healed properly.

I have an earlier review here from some months back.  Just took another of my pups over this week (general baseline visit) & was happy as I always am.  In addition, there is now a benefit to taking a dog adopted from a rescue organization - as all my dogs are - so I was even more delighted.  (This is previous review:  Have been taking my beloved dogs to Bernardo Heights, with Dr, Fenner, since 2009.  Have known Dr. Anderson for years, so was more than delighted when he took over at Bernardo Heights.  Dr. Anderson, & the entire staff, have been wonderful with not only my pups, but with the rescue dogs I foster for Lab Rescue.  They care about every patient at if they were their own.)  And a new additional comment.  When a friend was visiting from out of state, with her dog, a little over a year ago, the dog had what we thought was almost an emergency.  Called BHVH & they got us in immediately.  Turns out all was well, but my friend was so happy with Dr Anderson that when she was here earlier this year, she made an appt to have Dr. Anderson see her dog again!
I called them when I was visiting California.  They were kind gracious and accommodating.  I was impressed with the staff  cleanliness and level of care.

This clinic is the best I've been so far.
Came here for a PTLO surgery and considering making them my main veterinarian , even though they are 45 min away. Dr. Anderson and his staff are wonderful, informative, accommodating and very knowledgeable. They give me all the information and do not make the whole process feel rushed. Their pricing is very reasonable considering other clinic charge 4 to 5k for tplo and the complimentary nail trim while under anesthesia is something I really appreciate since other vets typically tack on an additional 20 to 30$. The front desk and technicians are all superb as well.

Have taken my cats and now my dog there for several years and have always been pleased with the courtesy and professionalism shown. Have been able to get timely appointments and my animals are welcomed very warmly. Highly recommend!

My dog, Sugar is like my “baby”. I know that’s a common sentiment among some pet owners - but Sugar is amazing and I shopped vet hospitals when I learned she needed some teeth extractions. I chose BHVH because from the moment I entered I could feel a difference. The reception area is a celebration of dogs - with huge framed portraits of dogs lining the wall. And the vet tech who explained the procedure was very thorough and transparent about the pricing. So, I took Sugar there (she is 12 in December) for some extractions. Turns out, she needed 11 teeth pulled including one canine. She made it through the surgery - was groggy afterwards and I took her home. But she was up and running the very next day. I was given very clear instructions prior to the surgery, along with written instructions and prescriptions to prep for the surgery. Afterward, more very clear instructions for how to care for her at home - and the instructions were given by caring professionals who clearly wanted the best outcome for Sugar. She is two days into her recovery and acting like a puppy already. I received a post surgery call from BHVH today to make sure Sugar was doing well. We also scheduled a follow up appointment a few weeks from now. But the kicker was that they also told me they’d made a mistake on my bill - and would be crediting my account over $300! Crediting - not charging more. After I’d already paid the bill. Let that sink in. Well, suffice it to say, I’m a customer for life 🙌
Very friendly, great vets and scheduling was quick and easy.   Highly recommended!
We have gone to BHVH for years, first Dr Fenner and now Dr Anderson and crew. We love how they all love our dog Nate and will continue to go there for all his needs.

Omgoodness... this is the place. Separate lobbies for dogs and kitties. Caring, cheerful and professional staff. Excellent Veterinary doctor. Great Veterinary dentist. Very fair prices. They get it. We went through a lot to find this team and recommend them to everyone who'll listen. Love 🐱 …

Dr Roberto was wonderful with our puppy.
She truly cares for animals.

Front desk and personnel were very friendly when we brought our puppy in. The reason for the two stars has been the up-sale of things that were unnecessary. Initial check up was because our puppy threw up and we were overly concerned. But by the time we took him in, puppy was looking back to his chipper self. Looked online and it noted that most likely he got rid of whatever made him sick if his appetite and energy was back to normal. Doctor said same thing but then mentioned taking a stool sample and x-ray which would’ve increased costs to $400+. Which I declined feeling less confident… but days showed puppy was all good.

We got our vaccinations done same day and called in a month later for a different check up, only to be told that because he’s overdue on one shot, he’d have to retake the series. I was baffled since the first place noted that he was done with that series so I really wasn’t expecting any news about it. So I took him into another vet who told me, based on his records, he was all set. So another instance of almost being up charged for 4 more shots and being a scared first-pup owner to boot.

Being able to trust that the vet isn’t putting my puppy through unnecessary procedures or shots is very important to me which was why I decided to go with another vet. Unfortunate because I really liked how close this one was to my home.

We recently had to make a difficult decision to say good-bye to our 18 year old kitty, Charlie.  His signs of aging and decline in health were evidence that it was time to visit Dr. Anderson.  Charlie was an anxious feline that only wanted to be held on his terms.  Dr. Anderson's gentle touch was welcomed and after a brief examination, he said euthanasia was a wise choice...a hard one, but best for kitty.  The procedure was explained with care and compassion and the entire staff comforted me through the process.  We have 2 other cats who have been treated at Bernardo Heights Vet Hospital.  It's always a pleasant and professional experience and I'm loyal fan!
Dr. Anderson is awesome as well as his staff. Doc really listened and now my teenage boy dog’s allergies are in control. Totally recommend this practice.
Excellent Docs and staff.
Dog leg surgery.   All went as planned.
Dr. Anderson and his team are wonderful
Great , service, staff and Wonderful Drs.who really  care about your pets health and well being.😁👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻🫷🏻😺 …

Wonderful front desk, techs, and doctors. I called ahead and talked to an admin who works at this location. We got a rescue from a kill shelter but she came with no vaccinations. We had called a few places and because they are a call center and not local on site where told it was okay to bring her in only to be turned away by on location  staff(see other post for more info). This location helped me get all of my pets information, shots, chip, and overall health check. They made it simple and straight forward, and easy. Thank you !
Drs. Anderson and Roberto are  always thorough and compassionate in caring for my animals.  The staff is very helpful and are always willing to help answer questions regarding pet care.

We met with Dr. Anderson for a consultation for our greyhound with a mysterious limp and he was wonderful. He took the time to listen to our concerns, had a gentle approach with her, and did not push nor recommend extra testing at extra costs.  We appreciated his honest and gentle approach and highly recommend him!

Always willing to get us in as soon as possible, polite professional, and thoughtful. Drs are always ready to help and good to make sure all needs are met!!!👍🏻😁😁😁😁
Thank  you, Shylo🥰 …
We LOVE Dr. Roberto! We drive from Oceanside to bring our Lucy here. They are all kind and caring! Prices are reasonable and not pushy or make you feel pressured.

This review is so overdue! I can’t say enough wonderful things about Dr. Roberto and the amazing staff here! They truly go above and beyond in every way. From emergency situations to phone calls with questions/answers, their level of care and genuine love for animals stands out so much more than other places I’ve been. Whether it’s regular checkups or just offering thoughtful advice, I trust them completely. I’m so grateful for everything they’ve done for my girls. I love, love, love this vet! Thank you all for your kindness and for taking such great care of my fur babies!
Wonderful doctors and staff. They took great care of my cattle dog after an extensive surgery and recovery. Each and every visit was a great experience!

Dr. Anderson has been my vet for over 13 years. I don’t know another vet who is more kind and caring. He is also well versed in international travel documents which we needed help with.
Thank you Dr. Mark for being all that you are!

Everyone has been wonderful there, I can't recommend them enough. Our dog had knee surgery and it went well and the the follow up process has been great. We intended only to go here for the surgery but we are now making them our main vet for our dog.
We are sorry you feel this way. If there is anything we could have done differently, please let us know. We hope Lex is doing well.
Lower priced. Funny though they were afraid of my 1 year old German Shepherd

When my dog needed TPLO surgery, I thought I was gonna be scammed when I saw how cheap BH Vet Hospital was offering the surgery at. Nope ! All in all, we saved around 2-3k coming here for our dogs TPLO surgery. Great customer service, super attentive staff , and a pleasant experience with Dr. Roberta. She explained the procedure and the vet techs went through a detailed portrayal of what recovery was gonna look like. We live out of state, but they still kept in touch with us to check on our pup and answer any questions we had. They coordinated with our local vet to make sure our pup had all the resources she needed. Would highly recommend them for anyone interested!
Our family and 7 precious animals have been greatly served by the vets and staff of Bernardo Heights Veterinary since 1997.

Thank your for the 5 star review, Tess!
Great place to take your pets. My 2 dogs and cat are treated very well there. Knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend them!
Thank you for the 5 star review, Lisa!
Hands down the most sincere veterinary hospital and staff that we've come across.  We are lifetime supporters of BHVH.

I can’t say enough good things about Bernardo Heights veterinary hospital. They have been incredible in caring for my dog, Gucci.
From the moment we walked in, the staff was welcoming, attentive, and professional. The veterinarians took the time to explain everything in detail and made sure that I understood all the options available for my dog’s treatment.

My dog usually gets nervous at the vet, but the team here made sure she was comfortable and calm throughout the visit. They truly care about their patients and go above and beyond to provide excellent care. I feel confident knowing that my dog is in great hands every time we visit.
Thank you Bernardo Heights veterinary Hospital.
I highly recommend  to all the pet owners.
Lily and Dr Roberto were very nice and friendly! Very informative and I appreciate there approach in care!
Thanks for the 5 star review, Janet!
Great place
All the staff at BHVH are very attentive, caring, and loving of our pets.  We appreciate the excellent care they provide to them!
